headline: Medallion Financial sells Pilbara Minerals as lithium price outlook becomes uncertain after sharp recovery

So it's very difficult to get a clean line of sight on what happens from here... I would be inclined to sell Pilbara just given you've done very, very well holding it over the last 12 months.
